name: ChEBI
rationale: Identity authority for chemical structures. CC BY 4.0, recorded in data/raw/MANIFEST.yaml.

name: CARD Antibiotic Resistance Ontology
rationale: Antibiotic molecule subtree, resistance determinants and drug targets. Academic-use terms accepted; recorded in MANIFEST.

name: PubChem
rationale: Structure fallback for CARD-only molecules. Only the CIDs CARD cross-references are fetched.

name: CARD card.json
rationale: CARD keeps the authoritative determinant-to-mechanism association here, not in aro.obo. The is_a+participates_in walk gets 4530 of 4555 rows typed; this would settle the remaining 25 and replace an inference with a source assertion. Same provider we already depend on, so the licence question is narrow.

name: MIBiG
rationale: producer_organisms is empty on all 2923 records and the schema already has the BGC accession field. Needs a compound-to-BGC mapping; MIBiG entries name products but not always with a structure identifier.

name: ChEMBL bioactivities
rationale: The largest source of MIC values that carry an assay description, organism and units. activity_spectrum is empty corpus-wide and the schema requires units and method, so an assay-less source cannot fill it.

name: Stanford HIV Drug Resistance Database
rationale: All 474 antiviral records carry empty resistance_mechanisms because CARD has nothing for viruses. This is the best-curated antiviral resistance resource; scope is HIV only, so HBV/HSV/influenza stay open.

name: NPAtlas
rationale: Natural products with structures AND their producing organisms in one record — closes producer_organisms and adds structures for compounds ChEBI lacks.

name: CO-ADD
rationale: Open screening data against a fixed ESKAPE panel with a stated protocol, which is exactly the assay context the schema demands.

name: BV-BRC
rationale: AMR phenotypes with organism, strain and method. US-government data, so redistribution is likely straightforward.

name: BacDive
rationale: Strain-level susceptibility from DSMZ. Sibling repos already consume BacDive, so the access pattern is known here.

name: DrugCentral
rationale: clinical_status is unset on every record; DrugCentral carries approval status and route with dates.

name: WHO ATC and AWaRe
rationale: ATC codes and the AWaRe Access/Watch/Reserve classification are what clinicians filter on. WHO publication terms need checking before anything is redistributed.

name: ChEBI entry citations
rationale: Already extracted into a citations column that nothing reads. A ChEBI entry's references support the COMPOUND, not necessarily an antimicrobial claim about it, so seeding them into evidence needs a stated rule first.

name: LOTUS
rationale: Natural-product occurrences linked to taxa, built on Wikidata. Overlaps NPAtlas; adopt one first and measure what the second adds.

name: COCONUT
rationale: Aggregated natural-product structures. Value here is coverage for minted records that have no ChEBI entry.

name: Norine
rationale: Nonribosomal peptides with monomer-level representation. Relevant because macrocyclic peptides are where a flat SMILES round-trip is most likely to be wrong.

name: ClassyFire and NPClassifier
rationale: Computed structural classes would give structural_class to the records CARD does not cover. Computed, not asserted, so it needs its own provenance marker.

name: antiSMASH database
rationale: Predicted clusters across sequenced genomes. Predictions are not evidence of production; useful for leads, not for seeding.

name: MEGARes
rationale: Resistance gene database with its own ontology. Largely overlaps CARD; adopt only if it covers determinants CARD misses.

name: DrugBank
rationale: Excellent data, but the licence does not permit redistribution in a CC0 knowledge base. Usable as a curator reference only, never seeded.

name: KEGG DRUG
rationale: Same shape of problem as DrugBank: freely readable, not freely redistributable. ChEBI already carries kegg.compound and kegg.drug cross-references, which is the useful half.

name: CLSI breakpoint standards
rationale: Paywalled standards documents. A curator may consult them; the corpus cannot carry them.

name: EUCAST breakpoint tables
rationale: Freely downloadable clinical breakpoints, but they are species-level clinical cut-offs rather than measured MICs — a different claim from what activity_spectrum models.
